marta: Heads-up — we need a quick cross-team sync. Product wants a compact 'cost per 1K tokens' tile in Console for next week's demo. Need runtime + infra inputs so numbers map to what we actually bill.

devon: to be precise: we need tokens_emitted (by model+route), kv_cache_hits (tokens), batch_size distribution, and gpu_seconds per request.

sasha: infra can export gpu_seconds and instance_type per allocation. also can map instance_type -> cost_per_gpu_second (hourly / 3600). okay to expose that metric?

alan: ideal UX: top-line cost/1k, then expandable breakdown: model, route, cache savings, batching delta, and canary vs prod split. Add option to compare last 7d vs baseline.

seong: agreed. suggested join keys: request_id or route_id + model_version + timestamp_bucket. SQL prototype:
```sql
WITH r AS (
  SELECT model_version, SUM(tokens_emitted) AS tokens, SUM(gpu_seconds) AS gpu_sec, SUM(kv_cache_hits) AS cache_hits
  FROM runtime_events
  WHERE ts >= '2026-03-01'
  GROUP BY model_version
)
SELECT model_version,
  (SUM(gpu_sec * cost_per_gpu_sec) / NULLIF(SUM(tokens) - SUM(cache_hits),0)) * 1000 AS cost_per_1k
FROM r JOIN infra_costs USING(instance_type)
GROUP BY model_version;
```

devon: small thing — treating cache_hits as zero-cost is ok for runtime but need to account for prefill/eviction overheads. maybe compute 'served_tokens' = tokens - cache_hits and 'cache_saving_pct' = cache_hits / tokens.

sasha: infra can add a daily rollup feed with fields: model_version, route, tokens, cache_hits, gpu_seconds, batch_p95, instance_type. will push as parquet to s3 + catalog table.

alan: product asks for one-click drilldown to see per-route examples and 1k cost history. also we need a canary flag so UI can show canary vs default.

marta: action items:
- devon: define runtime event schema (deadline Tue EOD)
- sasha: confirm cost_per_gpu_sec table and add rollup export (Wed)
- seong: prototype SQL and dashboard mock (Thu)
- alan: sketch UX flows + canary toggle (Thu)

marta: pinging @devon @sasha @seong @alan, please ack and add any blockers.

devon: ack. will post schema PR.

sasha: ack. no infra blockers but need model tagging in requests (model_version) — cc: @platform-ingest

seong: ack — will put basic viz in superset draft and link here.
